annotations.title: Request a German commercial register extract

description: Request an official extract from the German commercial register (Handelsregister) as PDF plus structured key facts. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 9 per company (documents + EUR 5).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

include_documents.description: Optional: also retrieve shareholder list / articles where available.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
